bair.note: source Z offsets kept; height raised to the visual body centre

jab1.name: Jab 1
jab1.notes: Transitions to jab 2 as early as frame 6

jab2.name: Jab 2
jab2.notes: Transitions to jab 3 as early as frame 7

ftilt1.name: Forward Tilt 1
ftilt1.notes: Transitions to Ftilt 2 as early as frame 10

usmash.name: Up Smash
usmash.notes: Charge hold is frame 24. Projectile generated on frame 35. Projectile explosion is active for 5 frames.

grenadePull.name: Neutral B (Grenade)
grenadePull.notes: Pull Pin animation takes 21 frames before you can throw or shield/dodge. Grenades explode on roughly frame 150. Grenade generates on frame 1. Grenade lasts 2.5 seconds until it blows up on its own.

grenadeThrows.name: Grenade (Neutral Throw, Smash Throw, Underhand Throw)
grenadeThrows.notes: Grenade collision and explosion vary slightly in damage

nikita.name: Side B (Nikita)
nikita.notes: Takes 27 frames to cancel with shield. 29 frame fist pump animation after a hit.

cypher.name: Up B (Cypher)
cypher.notes: Damage-based armor on frame 7—94. Frame 47 is the earliest you can cancel the move. To knock Snake off of Cypher you need to do 7% damage in doubles or 8.4% damage in singles with a single hit. To destroy the Cypher with multiple hits, it takes 13% in doubles and 15.6% in singles.

c4.name: Down B (C4)
c4.notes: Lasts 26.6 seconds until it blows up on its own.

pummel.name: Pummel
pummel.landing: Total frames includes 13 frames of hitlag.
